D_test_policy: D_test is used only for final gate evaluation, never for training, checkpoint selection, lambda selection, or epoch selection

decision_rules.P-LOCALONLY: full LocalFT helps but low-dimensional and finite-shrinkage options fail to preserve most of the gain.
decision_rules.P-LOWDIM: last-decoder-stage or decoder personalization has >=70% of full LocalFT mean closure with much lower local storage.
decision_rules.P-NONE: no personalized condition has stable negative Delta_global on the primary metric.
decision_rules.P-SHRINK: a finite lambda has negative Delta_global in all seeds and improves mean local-regret or closure relative to lambda=0.
decision_rules.P-SIMPLE: FedAvg_then_LocalFT has negative Delta_global in all seeds and mean gap closure >= 0.5.

lambda_selection_policy: all pre-frozen lambdas are reported; D_test is not used to choose a single winner
